title: The King's Secret Letters
synopsis: But she has never learned to write.
goal: Help Bun-i write her own letter before dawn.

options.label: Bun-i crying: SORRY
options.feedback: She broke nothing. Look at Mom.

options.label: Bun-i waving: GOODBYE
options.feedback: No. Bun-i is not leaving. She goes home tomorrow.

notes: V4 (docs/SEOUL_CASE01_V4_GAME_DESIGN.md §3.1): Bun-i's charcoal picture note (m1_picture_memo, made 2026-11-07). Three pictures of Mom are the traces; a cat, a bucket, a bird and her water drop are nothing; her three drawings of herself at the bottom are the places.

Every picture of Mom shows her giving (clothes, rice, carrying her in the rain); Bun-i says she never said one word back: the word for being given something is thank you. The chips are English: no reading of a bow is needed.
No writing is in the picture; the water drop is Bun-i's mark (c1: Case 02, 11 and the season's keepers).

learning.objective: 분이가 그림마다 한 영어 설명(어머니가 바느질하고, 밥을 주고, 비 오는 날 업어 준 일)과 "한 번도 그 말을 못 했다"는 말을 읽고, 편지에 쓸 말이 '고마워요'임을 추리한다.
expressions: Mom just gives me so much.

play.title: The Empty Letter
story: She has empty paper and drawings.

Bun-i drew Mom three times. Tap each picture.
Mom sews at night, by a lamp. She makes my clothes.
Mom gives me her rice. She says, "I am not hungry."
I was sick. Mom carried me to the doctor in the rain.
Then Bun-i drew herself three times, at the bottom.
Bun-i: "I am not leaving Mom. I go home to her tomorrow."
Bun-i: "And I broke nothing. Mom just gives me so much."
Bun-i: "I never said one word back."

notes: V4 §3.2: the Jejahae's shapes (h3): ㅁ the mouth, ㄴ the tongue on the upper gums, ㅇ the throat. The three pictures are V3's (faces turned left, so the tongue's red line bends like ㄴ).
ㄱ (the back of the tongue, bending the other way) and ㅅ (the teeth: no picture of them) are the letters left over: 60 ways to lay three, each wrong pair answered.
Every letter is the app's text (ShapeMatchBoard): never in a picture.

clueInputs.note: Bun-i will sign her letter with her water drop: what she cannot write yet.

learning.objective: 소라의 설명(ㅁ says "m", ㄴ says "n", ㅇ is the open throat)과 그림 이름(LIPS, TONGUE, THROAT)을 읽고 직접 소리 내 보며, 글자가 소리 낼 때의 입 모양을 본떴음을 찾는다.
expressions: The King's letters copy your mouth.

play.title: The Secret of Sounds
play.letter:
The King's letters copy your mouth.
ㅁ says "m". Say "mmm".
ㄴ says "n". Say "nnn".
ㅇ is the open throat. Say "ah".
ㄱ says "g". ㅅ says "s".
Look at the red line in each picture.
play.question: Put each letter on the picture it copies.
hints: Say each sound. Feel your mouth. Then look at the red line.
The tongue's red line makes a corner, like ㄴ. The throat's red line is round, like ㅇ.

feedback.giyeok:tongue: ㄱ bends the other way. Match the red corner.
feedback.giyeok:lips: ㄱ says "g". Say it: the back of your tongue goes up.
feedback.giyeok:throat: ㄱ says "g". Say it: the back of your tongue goes up.
feedback.siot:lips: ㅅ is teeth. No teeth here.
feedback.siot:tongue: ㅅ is teeth. No teeth here.
feedback.siot:throat: ㅅ is teeth. No teeth here.
feedback.mieum:tongue: Say "mmm". Which picture has closed lips?
feedback.mieum:throat: Say "mmm". Which picture has closed lips?
feedback.nieun:lips: Say "nnn". Where does the tip of your tongue go?
feedback.nieun:throat: Say "nnn". Where does the tip of your tongue go?
feedback.ieung:lips: ㅇ is round. Find the round red line.
feedback.ieung:tongue: ㅇ is round. Find the round red line.

transition: "Yes! ㄱ is the back of the tongue. ㅅ is the teeth," says Sora.
"A stronger sound adds one line: ㄴ, then ㄷ."

notes: V4 §3.3: Bun-i's first word, built block by block, left to right as words are written today (SyllableSpec.row). First sounds ㅇ ㅁ ㄴ, last sounds ㅁ ㄴ (no ㅇ: a last ㅇ was another letter, ㆁ, in 1446).
Each block shows its sound as it is built (the Revised Romanization), so a wrong part is heard: eo-ma, meom-ma, am-ma.
The word is today's spelling (dossier fiction). Every letter is the app's text.

clueInputs.note: ㅁ the lips (the first sound of ma, the last of eom), ㅇ the open throat (first, holding the place).

learning.objective: 소라의 규칙(점이 오른쪽이면 ㅏ, 왼쪽이면 ㅓ, LAST SOUND는 아래, 모음으로 시작하면 ㅇ이 먼저)과 분이의 소리 eom-ma를 읽고 엄마를 블록별로 조립한다.
expressions: A LAST SOUND sits under them, at the bottom.

play.title: Bun-i's First Word
play.letter:
A vowel is a line and a dot.
A standing line with the dot on the RIGHT is ㅏ. It says "a".
With the dot on the LEFT, it is ㅓ. It says "eo".
Each block has a FIRST SOUND, then a VOWEL beside it.
A LAST SOUND sits under them, at the bottom.
Does a block start with a vowel sound? Then ㅇ goes first. It holds the place.
play.question: Build Bun-i's word, eom-ma: tap a block, then choose its parts.
hints: Eom ends with closed lips. Put that letter at the bottom.
ㅓ: dot on the left. ㅏ: dot on the right.

feedback.어마: That says eo-ma. Listen: eom. At the end, the lips close.
feedback.언마: That says eon-ma. Eom ends with the lips, not the tongue.
feedback.암마: That is am-ma. Eo's dot is left.
feedback.멈마: That says meom-ma. Eom starts with a vowel sound: ㅇ goes first.
feedback.엄머: That says eom-meo. Ma has its dot on the right.
feedback.엄맘: That says eom-mam. Ma ends open: no last sound.
feedback.마엄: Say it with Bun-i: eom first, then ma.

transition: "I wrote my own word!" says Bun-i.
"It goes at the top," says Sora.
The King wants to see the letter.

lines.text: I want to write MOM. We say eom-ma.

evidence.name: Bun-i's First Word

notes: V4 §3.4. Stage 1: the King asks twice, shown evidence in turn: what Bun-i wants to say (e1), what she has written (e3). Stage 2: this puzzle: her first word among her practice papers (어마 has no last sound, 엄머 its dot on the left), and Sora's word for her message: Sora names a block of each of her three words (마, 미, 가요), so every word can be read; which one goes in the letter is Bun-i's message from M1 (thank you), never a block alone. Stage 3: the name, told after the answer (ending).
Words Bun-i has not learned are Sora's models (고마워요, 미안해요, 잘 가요): the player reads only the blocks learned in M2 and M3.
Every letter is the app's text: never in a picture. The King's words are made up (dossier fiction).

clueInputs.note: ㅁ the lips, ㄱ the back of the tongue: 마 is not 가.
Her first word, 엄마: not 어마, not 엄머.

learning.objective: 세종의 질문에 증거로 답하고, M1에서 찾은 메시지(THANK YOU)와 소라의 블록 단서(마·미·가요)를 M2·M3에서 배운 글자로 읽어 편지의 두 낱말을 고른다.
expressions: Thank you has the block 마.

play.caseSummary: Bun-i wanted to thank her mother in her own words. You found her message, learned how the King's letters copy the mouth, and helped her write 엄마, 고마워요. The King named his letters 훈민정음: the right sounds, to teach the people.

notes: Seoul Case 01 V4, 2026-11-07 (docs/SEOUL_CASE01_V4_GAME_DESIGN.md): Bun-i's letter to her mother. M1 what to say (her picture note), M2 how sounds become letters (the mouth), M3 her first word 엄마, the final her letter 엄마, 고마워요, then the name of the letters.
King Sejong appears and speaks: every word of his is made up (dossier fiction). Bun-i, Sora and Bun-i's mother are made up.
